labeller_note: Read every request prompt in content-batch.json in full (286 requests, 687 has units) plus the workflow YAML/registry for vocabulary only; labels judged from the whole request text, the earlier slot used only as a hint. Conventions: miRNA/small-RNA expression measurements (small-RNA-seq, miRNA qPCR/profiles) labelled expression; one-per-line miRNA ID lists labelled gene_annotation; exon lengths, cancer-gene lists and GMTs labelled gene_annotation; design/covariate/clinical/survival/responder tables labelled sample_annotation. Combined TF+miRNA prior files labelled tf_gene_prior (main piece) with the second piece noted in why. Per-sample measurement tables (expression, other omics, mutation calls) labelled made_by outside as measured data; priors, PPIs, annotation and design files labelled outside only when a public resource (STRING, JASPAR, TargetScan, MSigDB/KEGG, COSMIC, GTEx, TCGA, miRBase, 'downloaded') or another person/core is named, else not_stated; a NetZoo workflow is named only when the request says it produced the file (including filenames like panda_*_edges). Content not_stated when the words do not name the data kind (e.g. '36 pancreatic islet samples') or when the user gives alternatives across different content kinds (expression vs mutation, TF-gene vs co-expression network, mutation counts vs copy-number). certainty unsure when the user says they are not sure/do not remember/gives alternatives about what the data contains (including its transform, feature or sample count, somatic vs germline) or whether it comes from the same people; undecided future choices ('haven't decided') kept stated.

adjudication_note:
ROUND-27 phase 0: apply the content brief's own definition of `certainty` to the labeller's 53 `unsure` units.

Rule (CONTENT-SPOT-CHECK.md): a unit is unsure for C1 only when the alternatives the user gives for it map to
different `content` or different `made_by` values. Other doubts about the data (counts, transforms, sample overlap,
file format, single-cell vs bulk) keep `certainty_c1 = stated` and are left to the existing typed fields.
Writes content-labels-adjudicated.json (original labels kept, `certainty_c1` and `c1_note` added).
